pages.text: You're the new one. &6Kestrel Vane&r. Combat master.

&6Combat&r is simple. You hit things, they stop. Every monster you defeat gives &6Combat XP&r. Monsters have levels, shown on their name, and the further from home you roam, the tougher they get, and the better their drops.
Check your gear before a fight. Weapons and armour give &6stats&r like Strength and Crit Damage; your Profile page shows them. And know when to back off. Steel's only half of it.
Take this sword. When you're ready, go and see Brannoc, the blacksmith. He'll show you where real weapons are made.
